chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s own act of narration.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; the first link in the author’s chain.
key_terms.عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: From Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah; a transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ: From ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah; identifies the transmitter to whom this chain leads.
key_terms.عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: From Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr; a major transmitter in the chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah in the book. It documents the author’s route of transmission through named narrators back to ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, clarifying the provenance of those hadith.
